sn48.66:1.1: bhikkhave indriyāni || katamāni pañca || || Saddhindriyam || la-pe || paññindriyaṃ || || Imāni kho bhikkhave pañcindriyāni || || Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannam indriyānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā satta phalā sattānisaṃsā patikaṅkhā || katame satta phalā sattānisaṃsā || || Diṭṭheva dhamme paṭihacca aññam ārādheti || || No ce diṭṭheva dhamme paṭihacca aññam ārādheti || atha maraṇakāle aññam ārādheti || || No ce diṭṭheva dhamme paṭihacca aññam ārādheti || || no ce maraṇa kāle aññam ārādheti || atha pañcannam orambhāgiyānam saṃyojanānam parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti || upahacca parinibbāyī hoti || asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti || sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti || uddhaṃsoto hoti akaniṭṭhagāmī || || Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannam indriyānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā ime satta phalā sattanisaṃsā paṭikaṅkhā
